descriptions.d26c_actor_fire_or_shoot_800d973c: With a positive count at Desc+392, schedule through 0x800d8ed8 with a zero vector and the cached fire id, and play the Desc+440 sound through the audio service when it is not empty. Otherwise fire through 0x800ec6a8. Then allocate an 8-byte message with the cached done id and send it through 0x8015fc58.
